nba_forward_research.warning: Forecasts recorded before kickoff are research-only in a separate V8 Elo lane. History contains published ESPN scores captured now, and assumes 48h game-result maturity. A local digest and GitHub timestamp are not publisher-signed independent model/source authentication. No independent calibration, injuries or executable sportsbook prices. B2B and last-5/10 form features are saved but not weighted into Elo. Champion-001 shadows=0.

notes: Model p% means original model forecast only when actually supplied.
No-vig market p% and break-even p% come from quoted bookmaker prices, not model predictions.
Model edge (pp) = model p% minus break-even p%. EV ROI% uses decimal payout and model p.
Line movement in percentage points is not verified sharp money or bettor handle.
No betting recommendation without exact-market independently calibrated model, fresh authenticated price, player/game identity and pregame receipt.
N/A denotes unavailable evidence; it never means a zero-probability event or zero edge.
